title: 监狱机器人试用：AI 协助监督和应急响应
titleEn: Robot trials in prison: AI for inmate supervision and incident response
summary: 新加坡监狱开始试用 AI 机器人，协助监督囚犯和应对突发事件，提升安全性和效率。
summaryEn: Singapore's prisons are testing AI-powered robots to assist with inmate supervision and incident response, improving safety and operational effectiveness.
speaker: Nikhil Khattar
